question: Can I rent my home as a short-term rental, and what do I have to register or pay?

nuggets.text: A host applies for a short-term rental licence endorsement.
nuggets.quote: A host applying for a short-term rental license endorsement shall: (a) (1) Provide evidence that he or she complies with the requirements of § 30-201.02 ;

nuggets.text: Only the host's primary residence may be a short-term rental.
nuggets.quote: (d) The property at which the short-term rental is located shall be the host's primary residence.

nuggets.text: The host must carry at least $500,000 of liability insurance.
nuggets.quote: (b) A host providing a short-term rental shall have current liability insurance of at least $500,000, which may be provided by the booking service.

nuggets.text: The Department issues the endorsement only to the host.
nuggets.quote: (a) The Department shall not issue a short-term rental license endorsement to any person or entity other than to a host.

nuggets.text: The rental needs a basic business license with a Short-Term Rental endorsement.
nuggets.quote: (a) A short-term rental shall require a valid basic business license with a "Short-Term Rental" endorsement, in addition to any other license required by law.
